description.en: Hypothetical whole-animal Megarachne servinei, a non-marine aquatic eurypterid, not a giant spider. Fossils constrain the anterior shield, enlarged first two tergites and partial limbs; posterior body, telson, limb endings, depth and pose are inferred. Colour and the roughly 0.54 m body-length target are reconstruction choices, not complete-specimen measurements.
description.zh: Megarachne servinei 的假说性全身复原，属非海相水生广翅鲎，并非巨型蜘蛛。化石约束前部背甲、增大的前两节背板及部分附肢；后躯、尾剑、足端、体厚与姿势为推测。颜色及约0.54米体长目标属复原选择，非完整标本实测。

acceptance_obligations: Inspect all six diagnostic feature obligations against actual exported GLB views.
Measure actual exported triangles, materials, primitives, dimensions, file bytes and intended ground contacts against this brief.
Run source geometry checks, exact-GLB audit and official Khronos validation; review every warning with a concrete reason.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds using only declared relative dependencies and record semantic geometry/material agreement.
Bind current decision evidence, GLB and preview hashes; keep independent reviewer identity separate from maker and mapped privately to actual tasks.
Runtime GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN unless their own evidence exists.
No source reference images, internal locators or private URLs in public files; no hidden dependency on another model directory.

habitat.qualification: Alluvial/lacustrine sedimentology and suggested aquatic sediment-raking. Ecology and the large second-plate function remain uncertain. No environment base is exported.

inventory_corrections: Replace the inventory marine biome/tag inference with qualified non-marine aquatic context.
The second tergite is enlarged relative to posterior segments but is not the widest measured plate: first-tergite epimera span approximately 190 mm versus the second plate approximately 147 mm.
Use the approximately 0.54 m hypothetical total-body estimate, not the obsolete 339 mm supposed-spider body measurement.

morphology.inference_policy: Follow the conservative organization of figure 2, not its drawing as a mesh blueprint. Complete T3-T12 as ten small articulated tergites, largely overlapped anteriorly by the enlarged second plate; show several posteriorly before the telson. Their exact widths, depths and exposed lengths are authored estimates. Do not expose invented chelicerae or palps; conceal that underside region beneath the shield. Foot tips and minor blades are simplified completions, not claimed fossil details.
morphology.original_art_direction: Refined faceted low-poly aquatic arthropod. Deliberate lofted armor and limb profiles, not stacked untouched spheres. Desaturated olive-brown dorsal armor, slightly lighter ribs and rims, darker joints and underside; tiny dark eyes. Symmetrical resting benthic stance with negative space between all eight main limbs. No fur, props, floor slab, dramatic attack pose, or patterned soft-tissue claim.
morphology.pose_policy: At least the posterior three pairs form an unambiguous support footprint. Anterior raking limbs can be close to the floor and slightly forward. Keep the telson low, straight and free from self-intersection. State any final contact exceptions in evidence.
morphology.relief_policy: Use a restrained set of roughly 11 to 15 shallow ribs on tergite 2 and sparse small armor relief accents. Do not duplicate dense fossil surface ornament or introduce hair/spines all over the body. Ribs must remain embedded and not hover above armor.

required_features.fail_if: The anterior projection becomes paired fangs, a separate claw unit, or an extreme unsupported beak.
required_features.feature: Broad, low bell-shaped prosomal shield, wider at rear, with a single continuous modest downturned anterior projection and a median ridge.

required_features.fail_if: A spider-like cluster of eight eyes or huge stalked eyes is added.
required_features.feature: One pair of kidney-shaped lateral eyes beside a small median ocular mound; two tiny ocelli may be suggested on that mound.

required_features.fail_if: The first tergite is absent, replaced by a narrow spider waist, or reduced to an unshaped ring.
required_features.feature: Distinct sutured first tergite with shallow median length and longer leaf-like lateral epimera, immediately behind the prosoma.

required_features.fail_if: It reads as a balloon abdomen, a full fused horseshoe shell, an egg sac, or a smooth unsegmented spider opisthosoma.
required_features.feature: Large near-circular second dorsal plate, with readable shallow fan/radial ribs, overlapping the more slender reconstructed posterior body.

required_features.fail_if: Legs are hair-covered tarantula tubes, broad swimming paddles, giant lobster claws, or a mass of intersecting sticks.
required_features.feature: Four paired conspicuous limbs III-VI, stout low-sided articulated podomeres with expanded joints; modest blade-like projections on anterior pairs.

required_features.fail_if: An upcurled scorpion stinger, spider spinnerets, a crab abdomen, or a claim that the complete tail is preserved is introduced.
required_features.feature: A low tapering segmented posterior extension and straight lance-like telson, clearly treated as comparative reconstruction.

runtime_profile.materials: Opaque Principled/glTF metallic-roughness; metallic 0; mostly rough. Export normals and apply scale without negative determinants.

scale.basis: Holotype dimensions in the electronic appendix anchor the anterior body; total length follows the explicitly hypothetical figure 2, not a newly measured specimen. Pose width and height are original design values.

scientific_limits.en: Only the anterior carapace, enlarged first and second tergites and incomplete appendages are directly constrained. The posterior body, telson, distal limb completions, body depth and pose are inferred; chelicerae and palps are unknown and not exposed. Color is artistic. About 0.54 m is a reconstruction estimate, not a complete specimen measurement. The 2005 reassessment supports a non-marine aquatic setting, not the obsolete spider or a default marine animal.
scientific_limits.zh: 直接约束主要来自前部背甲、增大的第一和第二背板及不完整附肢。后躯、尾剑、足端补全、体厚和姿势均属推测；螯肢与须肢未知，不作外露细节。颜色为美术选择。约0.54米是复原估计，并非完整标本实测。2005年再研究支持非海相水生环境，不能沿用旧巨型蜘蛛形象或默认海生标签。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original stylized, hypothetical whole-organism reconstruction of Megarachne servinei, anchored to CORD-PZ 2110 and the second specimen described by Selden, Corronca and Hünicken (2005). Preserved anterior anatomy is distinguished from inferred posterior anatomy. Not a fossil scan, not a giant spider, and not a claim of complete anatomical knowledge.

temporal_context.locality: Pallero Member, Bajo de Véliz Formation, Santa Rosa II quarry, San Luis Province, Argentina
temporal_context.qualification: Latest Carboniferous, possibly earliest Permian in the primary appendix; no narrower coexistence or precise-date claim.

texture_policy.reason: Original material colors and restrained geometric relief are sufficient; no fossil photos or paper figures enter the asset.

view_plan.early_check: Three or four inexpensive gray-model views before final rendering.
view_plan.preview: Use the same bytes as perspective whenever possible.
view_plan.source: Clean import of final model.glb only; record GLB and render-config hashes.
view_plan.web_display: No extra website image is required at preparation or maker stage. The authoritative website renderer/config has not been verified here. Preserve canonical evidence; integration may later create required site derivatives without changing the frozen model.
